example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বাড়িতে কমলাসনা এসেছে, এখন সবকিছু সমৃদ্ধ হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Goddess Lakshmi has entered their home; now everything will prosper.
Lakshmi is worshipped on Diwali, seated on her lotus throne.
history: Refers to the Hindu goddess Lakshmi, who is depicted seated on a lotus flower, symbolizing purity and prosperity in Vedic and Puranic texts.
note: This expression is used metaphorically to invoke blessings of wealth and good fortune in Bengali Hindu culture.
